ev.q: 92 (12%) of the 750 attendees had symptoms of keratoconjunctivitis
Attack rates were significantly higher among persons sitting in closer proximity to metal halide lights
The attack rate was 14% (30 of 215) among persons aged <30 years
Among the 750 attendees, 92 (12%) met the case definition for keratoconjunctivitis
Attack rates did not differ by sex (females: 16% [13 of 80], males: 12% [79 of 670]; p = 0.25).
An investigation by the Field Epidemiology Training Program

methods_quotes.q: Attack rates among various groups were compared using a chi-square test, with the results expressed as p values.
